—Haah!!
Ah...!! Hey you, get back here—!!

Aight then, time for Golshi-chan's Waku-Waku Doki-Doki!?
Treasure Hunting Tour, babyyy!!

The Umamusume who called herself Gold Ship is barreling toward me!
If this keeps up, something terrible's gonna happen...!!

Though, how on earth did you end up
being the one chased?

It seems that Gold Ship girl
is quite the troublemaker.

Either way, since she can't find a trainer,
she probably just decided to kidnap one by force...

ORA ORA ORA ORA ORAAAAHHH!!
WHERE ARE YOUUUUU—?!

Her passion to race is wonderful, but frankly,
I'm not sure anyone could keep up with her...
Man, quit making no sense! If you keep standing around like that, some Umamusume looking for a scout's gonna snatch ya right up, ya hear?

I just need ya to come along on a liiittle bitty grand adventure with me.
So with that said, all aboard—!!

In order for an Umamusume to run in official races,
having a trainer is an absolute necessity.
(*SWOOSH!!*)

Stuffed inside a sack and hoisted onto her shoulder,
I was hauled off somewhere...

Getting tangled up with her would be disastrous, so I shall take my leave.
Please, take care of yourself as well...!
Wait, could you be a trainer?!

UOOOOOOHH!!
WHERE'S THAT STRAY TRAINER AT?!
Like, say... someone like the magnificent Gold Ship-sama right here!!
Sensing imminent mortal danger, I decided to haul ass out of there—!

Dammit, can't find 'em! But the Golshi-chan Radar
is definitely pointing right here—
However, Gold Ship-san is... how shall I put it, elusive? Unfathomable? Or simply... beyond words.

Whoa there, no need to be so terrified.
It's not like I'm gonna eat ya or anything.
—My days since becoming a trainer at Tracen Academy.

Fate has brought us together!
Time to bag me a stray trainer, ORAAAAAAAHHH!!

My eyes met with the bizarre Umamusume standing before me.
...I have a really bad feeling about this.
Hup, two, three—

You seem terribly out of breath.
Did something happen?
Aww yissss!! Target secured!!

Wait... where are they? If I remember right,
trainers are creatures with green skin and bared fangs—

Oh crap, I gotta run again!!
But by the time that thought crossed my mind, it was already too late—
Oho! Stray trainer, spooootted♪
—Aha!!
Goodness... it seems she's headed this way!
Still, what in the world was that just now...
Where on earth............ AM I?! (To be continued)

UORYAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—!!
OUTTA MY WAYYYYYYYYY—!!

“...Radar signal received. Radar signal received.
Trainer response detected in vicinity.”

I see... She certainly possesses plenty of passion
when it comes to wanting to race.

If the radar's pinging, there's no doubt about it!!
There's gotta be a trainer around here somewhere!!

Huh? What're you yammering on about?
Anyone wearing a trainer badge is a trainer, right?

*pant*... *pant*...
Dammit... Where are they?!

Good heavens, by Gold Ship-san?!
Well, how should I put it... my deepest condolences.
Watching the Umamusume train while letting my thoughts drift to an unseen, radiant future was a peaceful time...
I had hoped to eventually take charge of a girl myself and support her growth—or so I thought, but...

By the time I managed to escape behind the school building,
that Umamusume calling herself Gold Ship was finally nowhere in sight.

Crystal clear! Top marks! Blazing sunshine!
Perfect weather for some treasure hunting!
And then, several hours later—
Excuse me, you over there... Are you alright?
